{{Quote|The pirates that visit ''Hoth'' call this ''asteroid <nowiki>'</nowiki>Poison Moon,<nowiki>'</nowiki>'' because that's what it looks like from the surface.|[[Alysun Celz]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Poison Moon" />}}
The '''Poison Moon''' was an asteroid in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] encountered the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alysun Celz]] here.
